hypothesis.statement: The STACK_LAYOUT residual that defined this function for three passes is closed and the function has re-classified to SCHEDULE. slotdiff now reports SLOT MAP IDENTICAL: frame 248/248, the r19-r31 save set identical in both, and all eight slots (-248, 4, 36, 108, 188, 240, 248, 252) agreeing with the same use counts, where the pass started with ours at 32/104 against target 36/108. What remains is a 7-cluster emission-order residual with 10 mnemonic divergences and an IDENTICAL 121/121 multiset, and it is the SAME shape twice: in both arms of the `if (idx >= 0)` the target emits the text-buffer base address BEFORE the `color &= 0xff` mask and we emit them the other way round - target `addi r23,r1,108` @0x9c then `clrlwi` @0xa0 against ours `clrlwi` @0x9c then `addi r23,r1,108` @0xa0 in the first arm, and target `addi r25,r1,36` @0x108 then `clrlwi` @0x10c against ours `clrlwi` @0x108 then `addi r25,r1,36` @0x10c in the second. A third cluster at 0x84-0x94 is the same question for the shared zero constant, which the target materialises BEFORE the FixMLineText call and we materialise after it. So the whole remaining residual is 'the mask and the zero are scheduled one slot early relative to the buffer-base materialisation, in both arms'. The next lane should attack the MASK's position, not the buffer bases: the mask is a single source statement duplicated in both arms, and the buffer bases are hoisted out of the inlined TextLinesWidth, so the mask is the only one of the two that source can move. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT for whoever takes it: the frame is now exact and is bought by a declaration-count balance, so any probe that ADDS or REMOVES a declaration will re-open the slot map - measure slotdiff, not just real, after every probe here.
